label: Archive locking
type: cbbackupmgr's own file-based locking mechanism ensuring only one instance of the tool accesses a backup:archive at a time - used in place of SQLite's own file locking because network filesystems often do not implement it.
evidence: It's important that only one instance of cbbackupmgr has access to the archive at a time; this is enforced using a lockfile meaning most of the time you shouldn't have to worry about accidentally corrupting your backup.
Care should be taken to ensure that programs other than cbbackupmgr do not access the archive files whilst cbbackupmgr is running to avoid corruption.
